vocabulary.definition: a group of individuals born and living at the same time.
vocabulary.example: Each generation has its own unique characteristics and experiences.

vocabulary.definition: to provide what is needed or desired for a specific purpose.
vocabulary.example: The restaurant caters to a wide range of dietary preferences.

vocabulary.definition: having practical knowledge and understanding of a particular subject.
vocabulary.example: She is savvy when it comes to investing in the stock market.

vocabulary.definition: a standard or pattern that is typical or usual.
vocabulary.example: In their culture, punctuality is the norm for business meetings.

vocabulary.definition: existing in one from birth; inherent.
vocabulary.example: Her innate talent for music was evident from a very young age.

vocabulary.definition: having an excessive amount of knowledge or information.
vocabulary.example: The students in the debate club were hyper-informed about current events.
